_readme: The game's voice: dad jokes, one pool per moment (CLAUDE.md).
`shared` is every spot's fallback. `pond`/`stream`/`ocean` override a moment
with lines that belong to that water, so the Ocean never tells a pond joke.
A moment a spot does not name falls back to `shared`.
House rules, both checked by tests/data.test.mjs:
- every `cast` line keeps the literal instruction, at every spot: it is the
only thing on screen telling a beginner what to do.
- `junk` lines carry {it}, replaced with the junk item's name.
`wiggle` is an instruction too (F4) and shows with the jokes off, same as
`cast`. `niceCast` (A4) is praise for an even fly-cast cadence and is never
a scolding; `fishRun` (A7) is drama during a fight where nothing is at risk.
Add a joke here, not in app.js. Nothing else has to change.
